title: Capture products of stopped negative muons in Geant4 11.4.2 and 11.5.0.beta against measured yields
about: The setup, the measured anchors, the predicates, the rows and the rule of the benchmark, as fixed in four parts before and during the runs (see fixed). Each row compares one quantity of one configuration of one Geant4 revision with its measured reference.

fixed.relation_to_data: fixed before any Geant4 run of the benchmark
fixed.contents: the setup, the anchors, the rule, and the 25 predicates with their 150 rows

fixed.relation_to_data: fixed before any Geant4 run of the benchmark
fixed.contents: the f2 statistic on the full multiplicity, the gamma-line tag in the residual's rest frame, the per-line guards, the dataset binding and the 17 targets that are run

fixed.relation_to_data: fixed before any Geant4 run of the benchmark
fixed.contents: the f2.Pb and f2.Ag predicates and their 12 rows, from Table IV of MacDonald et al.

fixed.relation_to_data: fixed after data: after chunk 0 of all 102 cells, after 22 accepted cells of 11.4.2 and after the cell 11.4.2 bertini_pc natPb had been refused for its event 85953, whose capture step returned neither nuclear-capture nor decay products
fixed.contents: the treatment of events without an outcome and its rate guard (no_outcome)
fixed.erratum: the rate guard is a limit on how often such events may occur, not a guarantee that excluding them changes no verdict: counting such an event as a capture with no products moves it into the earliest 100000 captures and moves the last capture out, which can shift a quantity by more than the rate alone suggests; whether a verdict changes is measured by re-running the rule under that alternative treatment

seen_before_fixing.seen: a preliminary Geant4 11.4.2 run of aluminium-27, lead-208 and silver-107 targets: aluminium proton, gamma-line and neutron yields and the lead-208 and silver-107 neutron means
seen_before_fixing.what_was_chosen_without_it: the windows, k and the efficiency bracket were chosen from the sources and the study design, not from these numbers

seen_before_fixing.seen: the lead-208 neutron multiplicity of the preliminary run (its f2) and the silver-107 neutron mean
seen_before_fixing.what_was_chosen_without_it: the statistic, its support and the uncertainty model were fixed before the source was read; only the transcription and the arithmetic are new

setup.primary: a negative muon of zero kinetic energy at the centre of the box

geometry.material: one element: a single-isotope target is built from its Z and A; a natural target is the element G4NistManager::FindOrBuildElement builds, with its natural isotopic composition

setup.event_seed: seed_base + the global event number: a chunk that starts at event offset is run with --seed-base seed_base + offset, and the harness seeds event i of a run with its --seed-base + i (the --seed-stride value is passed and multiplied by zero)

bertini.reached: what an unmodified QBBC application receives

bertini_pc.capture: G4MuonMinusCapture -> G4CascadeInterface (Bertini) with the precompound de-excitation the variable switches on
bertini_pc.reached: what an unmodified QBBC application receives with the environment variable set

precompound.reached: opt-in by constructor registration: QBBC's stopping constructor replaced by G4StoppingPhysics("stopping", 1, false), whose third argument switches muon capture at rest off in that constructor; a constructor that adds G4MuonMinusAtomicCapture as the mu- rest process; and G4MuonicAtomDecayPhysics

setup.opt_in: --opt-in off on every cell: the switch exists only in a build that carries the dataset patches, and an unpatched build refuses on; no patched behaviour is scored

datasets.check: before a run the directory G4FindDataDir returns for each variable must equal the binding, and after the run the DATASET lines the run records must equal it again

classification.population: the earliest captures_per_configuration nuclear captures of the cell, in global event order; every event must classify as exactly one capture or one decay
classification.bound_decay: the primary's (track 1) single step whose process is muMinusCaptureAtRest; its secondaries whose creator model ends _NuclearCapture are the products, _DIO a decay; _EMCascade secondaries are ignored; both or neither is not a capture or a decay
classification.muonic_atom_helper: the muonic atom is the single non-primary track with recorded steps; the secondaries of its last step are the products; a decay iff they include PDG -12; no products is not a capture or a decay
classification.t_capture: the smallest global time among the products
classification.descendant_photons: photons whose parent is a nucleus created by the capturing track, emitted less than descendant_photon_window_ns after the capture

rule.edges: inside: |x - ref| = k sigma_tot is within the band
rule.fail: |x - ref| > k_fail sigma_tot and, for a row with rescue true, x outside [rescue_lo, rescue_hi]
rule.unqualified: otherwise: tension if |x - ref| <= k_fail sigma_tot, efficiency-limited if beyond k_fail sigma_tot but inside the rescue bracket

efficiency_bracket.r: r = eps0 / eps over [eps_lo, eps_hi]; r_lo = 0.545/0.65 rounded down, r_hi = 0.545/0.40

rule.rescue_edges: rescue_lo = r_lo ref - k_fail sqrt((r_lo ref_stat)^2 + (r_lo ref_syst)^2 + x_se^2) rounded down at 1e-12; rescue_hi = r_hi ref + k_fail sqrt((r_hi ref_stat)^2 + (r_hi ref_syst)^2 + x_se^2) rounded up at 1e-12; both edges belong to the bracket
rule.refusals: a missing row, an extra row, a reference cell that differs from this file or a rescue edge that differs from its recomputation is a refusal, never a verdict

no_outcome.rule: an event whose capture step returns neither capture products nor a decay (no_outcome) is neither a capture nor a decay: it is excluded from both denominators (events and captures) and reported per cell as n_no_outcome with its event ids, beside stops_total; the population is the earliest captures of the remaining events
no_outcome.guard: n_no_outcome / stops_total above rate_limit in any cell refuses the cell; exactly rate_limit passes
no_outcome.alternative: the same event counted as a capture with no products, which enters the earliest captures and moves the last one out; the rule is re-run on the alternative values

per_line.rule: on the selected population of every Al-27 cell, for each line: refuse if D_line > 0 and D_line > fraction (C_line + D_line), where C_line counts tagged capture-step photons and D_line descendant photons of a 26Mg parent within E_t x beta_max + the tag half-width of E_t, or if a tagged residual moves with beta >= beta_max

tag_width.rule: on every Al-27 cell, for each line: refuse if the count with 1 < |E* - E_t| <= 3 keV exceeds the continuum the sidebands predict there (4 keV x s / 20 keV) by more than k sqrt(continuum) + offset

guards.extension: a cell short of captures_per_configuration after its planned chunks takes at most max_extension_chunks further chunk
